lesson.menu_desc: Lost bag and wrong reservation + past simple -- 27 slides
lesson.subtitle: Lesson 5 -- When Things Go Wrong
lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Thiago Negrães | Lesson 5 -- When Things Go Wrong

items.situation: Your bag is not on the belt and everybody else has already left with theirs.
tips: Start with the fact in the past, then the request.
One adjective says the bag is not where it should be.

items.situation: The desk agent asks what happened on the way to the airport, and you have to tell the story.
tips: Every verb goes into the past.
Two of them are irregular: take and lose.

items.situation: The hotel tells you it has no room for you tonight because it sold too many.
tips: There is one adjective for exactly this.
Ask what they are going to do about it, politely.

items.situation: The airline offers you food at the airport instead of money.
tips: The paper or the code they give you has a name.
Ask whether you can have the money instead.

items.situation: Nothing worked at the desk and you want the problem on record.
tips: There is a noun for a statement that something went wrong.
Ask where you write it down.

listenings.text: Attention passengers of flight 214 from Chicago. Some bags did not travel with the aircraft this evening. If your bag is missing, please go to the lost and found office on the arrivals level and fill out a delayed baggage form. You will receive a reference number. We delivered every delayed bag from yesterday within twenty-four hours, and we expect the same tonight. If you paid for travel insurance, keep your receipts, because the airline does not refund what the insurance already covers.

Good evening, this is Daniel, the duty manager at the Riverside Hotel. I am calling about your reservation for tonight. Unfortunately the hotel was overbooked and we could not keep your room. We booked you a room at our sister hotel, four blocks away, and we paid for the taxi. You will also receive a voucher for dinner and a full refund of tonight's rate. I am very sorry. If this is a problem, please call me back and I will find another solution.

extra_audio.text: First, Thiago waited at the belt but his bag never arrived. Then he went to the lost and found office. After that, he filled out a form and gave the agent his address. Next, she said the bag was in Chicago and promised it for the morning. Finally, the airline sent him a voucher and a full refund.
